description:
VAO Blender is a security-conscious Blender extension for validating, inspecting, and importing supported Virtual Acoustic Object packages. Version 0.4.0-rc.1 implements the published VAO Standard 0.4.0, exact commit-pinned inspection and visual materialization for the VAO 0.5.0 candidate, and isolated compatibility readers for VAO 0.3.2 and 0.2.2.

The extension verifies carrier structure, manifests, release binding, inventories, byte sizes, SHA-256 fixity, immutable references, and validation completeness before media access. It provides paged metadata and diagnostic inspection, transactional visual materialization with durable provenance, explicit rights and capability gates, lifecycle-safe sessions, and a bounded content-addressed cache.

VAO Blender works offline, does not modify source packages, and does not execute packaged scripts. Modern VAO interaction/runtime execution, room-impulse-response convolution, acoustic simulation, and acoustic rendering remain outside this release. The VAO 0.2.2 audio preview executes only the fully compiled, explicitly supported interaction subset.
notes: Unreleased release-candidate metadata. No DOI or publication date has been assigned to 0.4.0-rc.1. Publication remains a separate maintainer action after the full native-platform evidence matrix is complete.
title: VAO Blender: A Blender Extension for Virtual Acoustic Objects
